cues: A homeowner tightens loose cabinet-hinge screws before the sagging door can scrape the floor.
The technician removes a small battery-cover fastener before replacing the remote control’s cells.
Furniture assembly begins as she secures each metal bracket with short threaded fasteners.
A monarch butterfly rests beneath a leaf while rain beads along its orange wings.
At sunrise, frost melts from meadow grass as warm light reaches the valley.
A choir rehearses softly in the concert hall while evening light fades outside.
